   '3' => 700,\n      '4' => 1100,\n      '5' => 1800\n    }\n\n    level_thresholds = {\n      3 => { easy: 75, medium: 150, hard: 225, deadly: 400 }\n    }\n\n    counts = Hash.new(0)\n value\n      end\n    end\n\n    base_xp = 0\n    monster_count = 0\n    monsters.each do |monster|\n      cr = monster[:cr].to_s\n      count = monster[:count]\n      base_xp += xp_table[cr].to_i * count\n      monster_count += count\n    end\n\n    multiplier = case monster_count\n                 when 1 then 1\n                 when 2 then 1.5\n                 when 3..6 then 2\n                 when 7..10 then 2.5\n                 when 11..14 then 3\n                 else 4\n                 end\n\n    adjusted_xp = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n\n    difficulty = 'trivial'\n    %i[easy medium hard deadly].each do |level|\n      difficulty = level.to_s if adjusted_xp >= thresholds[level]\n    end\n\n    recommendation = case difficulty\n                     when 'trivial' then 'no threat'\n                     when 'easy' then 'safe warm-up'\n                     when 'medium' then 'balanced challenge'\n                     when 'hard' then 'risky fight'\n                     when 'deadly' then 'deadly encounter'\n                     end\n\n    [base_xp, adjusted_xp, difficulty, monster_count, recommendation]\n  end\nend\n\nget '/health' do\n  content_type :json\n
